title: Kultainen linna: Satuja Suomen lapsille
summary: "Kultainen linna: Satuja Suomen lapsille" by Alfred Saukkonen is a collection of children's fairy tales written in the early 20th century. The elderly parent warns his three sons about the significance of an old superstition concerning the good fortune that resides in the treetops. While the eldest brothers dismiss this notion, the youngest, Jörre, faces turmoil when his brothers leave home to seek their fortunes and inadvertently create difficulties for themselves due to jealousy and greed. Jörre, initially perceived as sluggish and unfortunate, ultimately discovers that an encounter with a magical being and a touch of luck can transform his fate, leading him to unexpected wealth and prosperity, thus setting the stage for further adventures in the collection.
